title: "How frequently do you use generative AI tools in your RSE-related tasks (e.g., coding, documentation, testing, or design)?"
question_id: genAI1_0
---

```{r}
#| include: false
#| file: ../R/_load_common.R
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
question_code <- "genAI1_0"

nordic_countries <- c(
  "Finland", "Norway", "Sweden", "Denmark", "Iceland", "Estonia"
)
country_groups <- list(
  Nordics = nordic_countries,
  Germany = "Germany",
  Netherlands = "Netherlands"
)
plot_countries <- countries_from_groups(country_groups)
```

## Nordics

### Descriptive Statistics

```{r}
#| echo: false

print_heatmap_category_table(
  FILTER,
  question_code,
  header = "Generative AI usage frequency (Nordics)"
)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6

plot_heatmap_category_barplot(

  question_code,
  title = "Generative AI usage frequency (Nordics)"
)
```

### Statistics by age group


## Within Nordics

```{r}
#| echo: false

print_heatmap_category_table(
  nordic_countries,

  group_by = nordic_countries
)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 10

)
```

## Between Countries

